description: This file defines the SavePerformanceTrackerController class, which extends an abstract controller to manage the persistence of performance tracker data within the OrangeHRM performance module. It prepares different Vue.js components depending on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the HTTP request, indicating whether to edit or create a new performance tracker.

classes.name: SavePerformanceTrackerController
classes.description: Controller for saving performance tracker data, extending AbstractVueController to handle Vue.js component setup based on the request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue.js component for rendering. Selects 'performance-tracker-edit' if an 'id' is provided in the request, otherwise defaults to 'performance-tracker-save'. Sets the component for rendering.
